note: General MDM concepts (golden record, hub-and-spoke, match/survivorship rules) are standard enterprise-architecture practice and not Salesforce-specific. The one Salesforce-specific claim in this lesson -- that Data Cloud's identity resolution produces a 'Unified Profile' / 'system of reference' rather than overwriting source records, built via an Identity Resolution ruleset with match rules such as fuzzy name and normalized email -- was verified against Salesforce's own developer workshop documentation. No screenshot was used; this course's Chapter 3 is conceptual/architecture content taught through prose and tables, never UI click-paths.
